ingredients.name: tuna steak, cut into 4 portions (3 ounces each)
low-sodium chickpeas, drained and rinsed (or garbanzo beans)
tomato, rinsed and cut into wedges

steps.instruction: Preheat the broiler on high, with the rack 3 inches from the heat.
steps.spoken: Preheat the broiler on high with the rack 3 inches from the heat. You can heat a grill pan on high instead.

steps.instruction: Mix 1 tablespoon each of oil, garlic and oregano with 2 tablespoons of lemon juice.
Brush the mixture over 12 ounces of tuna steak, cut into 4 portions.
Let the tuna marinate for 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Let the tuna marinate for 5 to ten minutes.

steps.instruction: Mix 1/2 can of chickpeas and 1/2 bag of spinach with 1 tablespoon of lemon juice.
Add 1 tomato cut into wedges, and 1/8 teaspoon each of salt and pepper.
Grill or broil the tuna on high for 3 minutes.
steps.spoken: Grill or broil the tuna on high for 3 to four minutes.

steps.instruction: Flip the tuna and cook the other side for 3 minutes.
steps.spoken: Flip the tuna and cook the other side for 3 to four minutes, until the fish looks opaque and flakes easily with a fork. A thermometer should read 145 °F.

steps.instruction: Serve 1 tuna steak over 1 cup of the salad.
